{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Americans are troubled by humanitarian catastrophes in Africa including conflicts in Sierra Leone, the Great Lakes region, the Horn of Africa, and elsewhere.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The risk of famine is never far away in Africa.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Millions of people in Africa live in poverty and suffer from disease, especially AIDS and vaccine-preventable diseases that prey on children.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The situation in Sudan demands special attention due to its employment of the slave trade and its persecution of Sudanese Christians.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The government of Zimbabwe's refusal to adhere to the rule of law is deplored.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The conflict in Angola should be resolved through dialogue leading to the release of political prisoners and democratic government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The people of Africa need economic opportunity, foreign investment, and access to markets, food, and medicine.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will support international organizations and non-governmental organizations that can improve the daily lives of Africans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States must work to promote democracy and sound governance in Africa, and the prevention and resolution of conflict.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will help Africa achieve its economic potential by implementing measures to reduce trade barriers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will not ignore the challenges of Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
